vibe_rationale: Rider-led moto, rock and beach camping festival with a custom bike show; strong single-scene core.
fit_notes: Adult moto riders camping for several days have real hydration and recovery needs, but there is no sponsor precedent and wellness adjacency is weak. A fatal on-site crash at the 2026 edition and an unclear future at Vinuesa are reputational concerns, and a local partner would be needed.
